notes: PROMPTS.md was written for Gemini; this workflow generates images by hand in ChatGPT. Prompt text is used verbatim; only the surrounding instructions mention ChatGPT.
PROMPTS.md says 'Total: about 55 images. Night first; each day version attaches its night version.'. Parsing found 64 required assets plus 1 optional (H4).
PROMPTS.md specifies aspect ratios (21:9, 16:9, 3:4, 1:1) but no pixel dimensions; size checks compare ratios, and day/repaint versions are compared to their approved source.
Design doc referenced by PROMPTS.md (docs/plans/2026-10-19-little-planet-design.md) is not in the repository.

how_to_use.1: Gemini (gemini.google.com), image generation (Nano Banana). Always the largest size offered.
how_to_use.2: Work in ORDER, step by step. Later prompts attach earlier results to keep the style locked.
how_to_use.3:
Each prompt has an ID (B1, C4, E7 ...). Save the result as that ID in
docs/plans/assets/planet/incoming/B1.png
Several tries: B1-1.png, B1-2.png ... (keep them all; tell Claude which one you like).
how_to_use.4:
"ATTACH:" = upload those files with the prompt (paperclip / + button).
The style plates are in docs/plans/assets/planet/style/:
night.png  (the approved night scene)      day.png  (the approved day scene)
you.png    (you in the suit)
how_to_use.5: Copy everything between the ---8<--- lines, exactly.
how_to_use.6: Ratio: use the ratio named in the prompt (16:9 or 21:9). If Gemini refuses it, take the closest.
how_to_use.7:
Regenerate if you get: text, letters or numbers; black outlines; a glossy 3D or photo look;
a watermark; a background that isn't perfectly flat (for cut-out pieces).
how_to_use.8:
STOP POINTS (marked >>> STOP) — send those files to Claude before continuing. Claude runs them
through the pipeline to check cut-outs, seams and alignment, so a problem is found on 2 images,
not 20.

key_colours: - MAGENTA  #FF00FF  — buildings, ground, props, the character.
- GREEN    #00FF00  — clouds, planets, nebulae, sky objects (they contain lilac/purple, which a magenta background would eat into).
The key colour must be perfectly flat: no texture, paper grain, shadow, glow or gradient on it.
